bundle.shortDescription: AI-assisted tier list studio with clean client-area recording
bundle.longDescription: TierForge turns a prompt into a themed tier list with real, locally cached images. Drag items across S-F rows, customize tiers, and record a clean H.264 MP4 of the board without window chrome, controls, or the taskbar.
